articles.summary: Real-world examples of LLM hallucinations and other failures that can occur in LLM-powered products in the wild, such as prompt injection and out-of-scope usage scenarios.
articles.title: LLM hallucinations and failures: lessons from 5 examples

articles.summary: This tutorial shows how to create, tune, and use LLM judges. We'll make a toy dataset and assess correctness and verbosity. You can apply the same workflow for other criteria.
articles.title: Wrong but useful: an LLM-as-a-judge tutorial
